import json, subprocess, sys
a = chr(0x65) + chr(0x301)   # decomposed

req = {"services": [a, b], "rules": [], "queries": []}

p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
